_doc: Bootstrap template — MUST stay in sync with repo .cursor/hooks.json (7 events). Verified by scripts/ci/check-cursor-hooks-parity.sh and policy_contracts.

beforeSubmitPrompt._doc: Review gate + goal entrypoints: stdin JSON → router-rs BeforeSubmitPrompt

stop._doc: Review gate + closeout: stdin JSON → router-rs Stop (no hook GOAL_CONTINUE)

sessionStart._doc: TOKEN REDUCTION: compact project briefing (~300 tokens) at session start.

sessionEnd._doc: 会话结束：清 hook-state（review gate）。ROUTER_RS_CURSOR_KILL_STALE_TERMINALS=0 时不 terminate 终端（见 .cursor/router-rs-hook.env）。

postToolUse._doc: PostToolUse 门控（subagent multiset / shell 账本）；非门控工具由 router-rs fast-path 跳过。timeout 20s：慢盘时避免子进程挂死拖垮 Agent 步。

subagentStart._doc: 更新 review gate：pre-goal subagent 计数 / phase；open subagent 限流。

subagentStop._doc: subagent 结束：推进 phase，供 Stop/beforeSubmit 门控消费。
